## Line 38

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/color.library.plato, line 38](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/color.library.plato#L38).

```plato

    // Component-wise linear interpolation in linear light; t is unclamped.
    Lerp(a: Color, b: Color, t: Number): Color
        => (a.R + (b.R - a.R) * t,
            a.G + (b.G - a.G) * t,
            a.B + (b.B - a.B) * t,
            a.A + (b.A - a.A) * t);
```
